 Posted on October 26, 2026 
 FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE October 26, 2026 
 Carver and Key Recreation Centers to Close on Election Day - Tuesday, November 3 
 CHARLOTTESVILLE, VA –  Charlottesville Parks & Recreation’s Carver and Key Recreation Centers will be closed on Tuesday, November 3, 2026 for Election Day. Key Recreation will be closing at 5:00 PM on Monday, November 2 for election set up. All programs, classes, and drop-in activities are cancelled!
 Carver Recreation Center is located in the Jefferson School City Center at 233 4th Street NW, which is accessible via Main Street and Preston Avenue. Key Recreation Center is located at 800 East Market Street. For more information, please contact Carver Recreation Center at 434-970-3053 and Key Recreation Center at 434-970-3047, or visit www.charlottesville.gov/parksandrec .
 Media Contact: Nancy Burney Carver Recreation Center Manager Charlottesville Parks & Recreation 434-970-3622 burneyn@charlottesville.gov
